# Input validation
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive (all entries <= 0)")
    
    # Check shapes match
    shape0 = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape0 or logp_no_call.shape != shape0:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    
    # Check tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a number")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = shape0
    
    # Compute normalized future-token weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    
    # Compute weighted future-token losses (lower is better)
    def weighted_loss(logp: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return -np.sum(norm_weights * logp, axis=1)
    
    L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)
    L_empty = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)
    
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    
    # Margin
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    
    return keep, margin
